prompt: You wish to apply for a new college course, but you are unsure about the details posted on the college website. Write an email to the relevant person in admissions at the college, ask him, - in which course you are intrested in. - Course cost, duration, and subjects. -Deadline of application.
essay:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to enquire about the Software Automation course advertised on your college website. I have gone through the information provided, but I would appreciate some clarification as the website contains only limited details about the programme.

Firstly, I would like to know the total cost of the course. Could you please provide a breakdown of all the fees, including tuition charges, examination fees and study materials? Secondly, according to the website, the course lasts for one year. I would be grateful if you could explain how it is structured, particularly whether it is divided into semesters or delivered as a full-year programme.

I would also like to know more about the subjects covered. As software automation encompasses several areas, such as data migration, automation tools and test-case development, I would appreciate it if you could provide a detailed list and description of the modules included in the course.

Finally, could you please let me know the deadline for submitting an application? If possible, I would also appreciate a copy of the latest course brochure, including information about former students' experiences, as this would help me make an informed decision and plan accordingly.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to receiving your response.

Yours faithfully,

David Smith
